## User value and scope
- What concrete user problem does this solve?
- Why is this flow preferable to the existing or simpler alternative?

## UX / design review
- [ ] Material 3 / Android quality guidance considered; any Mobbin/Figma comparisons are identified and actually available
- [ ] Consistent layout, spacing, typography, contrast and clear primary action
- [ ] Keyboard, system insets, font scaling, small phone, tablet and landscape checked where relevant
- [ ] Accessible controls, labels, tap targets and navigation
- [ ] Loading, empty, error, offline, retry and permission states addressed
- [ ] No feature bloat, dead UI controls, unexpected autoplay or misleading copy

## Reliability / safety review
- [ ] Existing user data, preferences, account state and upgrade compatibility preserved
- [ ] Privacy, secrets, permissions and destructive-action confirmation checked
- [ ] Relevant build, lint and tests run; results recorded below
